review_notes.summary: Served process builds one baseline and exposes /run through the committed binary entrypoint.
Baseline construction creates provider-backed model instances; no pre-model response is established by the inspected constructor.
Scored run path is implemented in Baseline::run and explicitly handles validator tool endpoints; downstream dispatch still requires tracing.
Reachable production module contains benchmark-version-specific money slot conversion helpers; need confirm whether served response writer invokes them.
Live baseline source contains request/output-shaped currency conversion and prose-to-answer extraction leads; authority and reachability must be traced.
Production prompt deck contains benchmark-specific money formatting and extensive closed tool/family routing rules; trace injection into deciding model.
Store uses request-driven memory retrieval with learned predictor and cross-encoder reranking; this is allowed absent a served answer compiler.
Provider credentials are read for model construction; policy permits harness-owned inference credentials, but alternate provider handling remains to verify.
Release entrypoint routes POST /run directly to Baseline::run and POST /seed to request-scoped ingestion; no alternate opaque runtime is selected.
Inspected path uses request-driven retrieval and reranking; no cross-user record sink or static answer table was found in this area.
Normal scored path invokes the shared model turn loop with live tool catalog and request-derived prompt inputs before response construction.
Reachable /run path classifies closed money and world families, selects shape/decline retries, and performs draft acceptance/replacement decisions based on family semantics.
Specialized lexical retrieval remains parameterized by the request user and feeds model context; no cross-user sink is shown in the inspected queries.
The served controller identifies closed answer families and rejects or retries parseable drafts using family-specific semantic shape tests, constraining model authority.
Served controller classifies benchmark-shaped money/world families and retries parseable drafts on family-specific semantic shape, constraining model authority.
Reachable final writer synthesizes final_text and answer from decline constants or first prose line after model output, changing scorer-visible fields.
Served retry policy branches directly on bench_version and uses benchmark-specific world/family routes and prompt closers.
Observed non-memory tools execute one POST to the supplied endpoint with model-selected name and arguments; response is returned to the model.
Removal lifecycle state is process-global but keyed by request user; ordinary memory SQL retrieval binds the request user.
Release /run path reaches Baseline::run and no opaque runtime replacement is selected by the Docker entrypoint.
Served response path branches on benchmark version and applies request-family-specific answer-slot mining and rewriting after model output.
Final served writer synthesizes missing answer fields from prose or a fixed decline after the model/tool path, changing scorer-visible authority.
Reachable controller classifies closed monetary and world answer families and retries parseable drafts based on family-specific semantic shape predicates.
After genuine calls, runtime derives a request-keyed critical-tool plan and narrows the next exposed capability by family and prior execution history.
Served retrieval binds ordinary run context to the request user, while reranking uses live records rather than a static answer table.
Opening and retry paths invoke provider-backed model completions; no universal pre-model answer writer was found in the inspected route.
Release /run handler directly calls the committed baseline and Docker copies the built binary, with no opaque entrypoint replacement.
When supplied, each HTTP tool call posts once to the exact request endpoint with model-selected name, arguments, user, case, and hop.
